system.description:
Requirements: Soul (5), 6 White Fox abilities, and you must receive training from another Elder White Fox, or have access to their teachings.

Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: Self

You have mastered the White Fox’s arts of trickery and fate.

As an Action, you may grow nine ethereal fox tails to empower yourself.

  • Your Body and Soul increase by +2.

  • Your Stride speed increases by +5.

  • Other creatures have Disadvantage to resist the effects of your spells or Path abilities.

  • Once per turn, when you would be hit by an attack or targeted by a hostile spell or ability, you may substitute yourself with an illusory clone that disappears shortly after the triggering action, while you reappear at a location of your choice within 30 spaces. As you reappear, you may immediately make a Stealth check to hide.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.

Additionally, White Foxes and other followers of the Path of the White Fox will recognize your skill and afford you special respect.
